about_short_description.short_description: Right Calories is a Bahraini health-conscious restaurant that provides exactly calculated nutrition and affordable meals

product.name: Main Dishes
product.description: A variety of main dishes including Tenderloin Beef Steak with Mashed Potato, Portobello Mushroom Chicken, Buffalo Shish Tawook with Lemon Rice, Sesame Chicken with Brown Rice, and Grilled Salmon with Jasmine Rice.

product.name: Salads
product.description: A selection of salads such as Mixed Berries Quinoa Salad, Grilled Chicken Halloumi Salad, and Caesar Salad with Crispy Baked Chicken.

product.name: Appetizers
product.description: Various appetizers including Yellow Lentil with Peppers and Crispy Tortilla.

product.name: Pizzas
product.description: Whole wheat pizzas including Margherita, Chicken Tandoori, Grilled Vegetable, Black Beef, Mixed Mushroom, and Pepperoni.

product.name: Burgers
product.description: Different burger options like Baked Crispy Chicken Burger and Chicken Sliders with Potato Wedges.

product.name: Sandwiches
product.description: Sandwiches such as Pepper Roasted Chicken Sandwich, Chicken Mushroom Quesadilla, and Baked Shawarma with Ranch Sauce.
